topic: you become who you spend time with
lines: #Look at the people you spend the most time *with.*
But because we *become* what we're around.
Even when you don't *notice* it happening.
If everyone around you builds, you'll *build.*
Five people. That's who shapes how you *think.*
How you *talk.* How far you believe you can go.
But you do need to add people who pull you *up.*
Find them online. In a gym. In a class. In a *book.*
Listen to people who are where you want to *be.*
#Spend more time around ambition, and you'll *catch* it.
And be that person for someone *else.*
The one who makes the room *better.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: The People Around You Are Your Future
post.caption: Habits are contagious. Choose your room carefully. 👥
post.first_comment: Tag someone who pulls you up 👇
